items.title: Mariah Carey Checks In for Christmas in Gucci's 2026 Holiday Campaign
items.summary: WWD covers Gucci's new holiday gift campaign starring Mariah Carey, directed by Harmony Korine, built around her 'All I Want for Christmas Is You' anthem and pieces from the new Butterfly collection. Framed as a major activation launching the brand's holiday push in the US market.

items.title: Gucci and Mariah Carey Celebrate the Holidays with a Cocktail Party
items.summary: Gucci hosted a cocktail event at its Fifth Avenue New York flagship on the Monday night prior, where Mariah Carey was serenaded by an a cappella choir performing her Christmas hits; she distributed Gucci-branded chocolate boxes to attendees. Coverage reads as straight activation/event reporting.

items.title: Mariah Carey x Gucci: The Queen of Christmas' Luxe Butterfly Era
items.summary: Reports that Carey wore more than $50,000 worth of Gucci across her two campaign looks, reinforcing the price-extravagance framing of the holiday push; US entertainment press picked up the campaign widely, extending reach beyond fashion trade outlets into celebrity media.

items.title: Kering Q3 2026 earnings call: Gucci North America sales turn negative
items.summary: Kering management confirmed Gucci North America comparable sales growth slowed sharply to roughly -10% in Q3 from +10% in Q2, blamed on a tough comp base and fashion-forward collections skewing to top-end clientele while aspirational shoppers pulled back. CFO called the quarter's performance 'not where we want it to be'; North America store count also saw 23 net closures.

items.title: Kering shares tumble as Gucci fails to reassure investors
items.summary: Kering stock fell roughly 11-12% after Q3 results showed Gucci sales down 6% organically, worse than analysts' -5.4% consensus. Deutsche Bank said Gucci 'has not shown convincing signs of stabilisation'; JPMorgan noted desirability gains are at a 'very early stage'. US investor coverage ties directly to the North American demand picture.

items.title: Kering Q3 Earnings 2026: Revenues Flat as Gucci Misses
items.summary: WWD's earnings writeup details Gucci's 6% organic sales decline against a flat group total, with jewelry and eyewear offsetting Gucci's drag; store closures raised to at least 125 net for the year. Serves as the sober trade-press counterweight to the holiday-campaign activation wave.

items.title: Demna's Gucci: Industry Experts React to Designer's First Collection
items.summary: Trade commentary remains split on Demna's debut: Bernstein scored the fall 2026 collection 7.6/10 (behind other recent debuts but ahead of Sabato De Sarno's). Critics called shoes and bags uninteresting and leggings 'vulgar', while defenders praised the storytelling and 'Gucci family' concept; several compared the aesthetic unfavorably to fast fashion.

items.title: Gucci SS27 Show thread
items.summary: PurseForum members discuss the Gucci Spring/Summer 2027 show; the original poster called it 'very commercial' with accessible advertorial-style accessories, liked the attitude and styling but felt there were no standout pieces. Thread remains an active discussion anchor referenced in newer PurseForum activity into November.

items.title: The Scene-Stealing Bags We Spotted Outside Gucci's Spring 2027 Show
items.summary: PurseBlog editorial rounds up street-style bag sightings from Gucci's Spring 2027 show arrivals, a recurring community-adjacent content format that drives forum traffic; tone is descriptive/enthusiast rather than critical.

items.title: @gucci Instagram engagement snapshot, early November 2026
items.summary: Third-party analytics show Gucci's recent Instagram posts (as of Nov 2) logging likes ranging roughly 3,952-12,199 and comments 69-110 per post, with ~52.3 million followers and an engagement rate the tool flags as below category average (~0.12%). Used here only as an aggregate SNS-volume indicator, not an individual post citation.

items.title: Gucci on Social Media in 2026: Views, Engagement and Top Posts
items.summary: Aggregator reports Gucci's last-30-days cross-platform performance at roughly 8.5 million views and 117.8 thousand engagements across 9 posts (about 1.4% engagement rate), used here only as a directional SNS buzz-volume signal, not for any single post's figures.

items.source: Fashion Chit Chat (Substack, independent fashion critic)
items.title: Gucci Has Lost the Plot. But What If It Works?
items.summary: Independent fashion commentary argues Gucci under Demna 'feels cheap' to industry insiders even as it may be succeeding commercially with a broader, less insider-focused audience; frames the brand's direction as deliberately bypassing fashion-critic approval. Representative of the critical-angle discourse circulating in US fashion commentary circles.

items.title: Gucci unveils a new side of itself on Avenue Montaigne
items.summary: Trade coverage of Gucci's new Paris flagship concept ('The Store Show'), first introduced in Milan, now rolling to a four-level Avenue Montaigne location including a private 'L'Appartamento Gucci' space. Though a Paris opening, the story is carried by a US-facing trade outlet and discusses the retail-format strategy relevant to Gucci's North American store network decisions too.
